name: io.github.aviation-0/meshtree
title: MeshTree
description: Coordinate parallel AI coding agents across git worktrees and machines

environmentVariables.name: MESHTREE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to an installed meshtree binary (default: meshtree on PATH, else the release binary is downloaded)

tools.name: spawn_task
tools.description: Create an isolated task worktree and branch (optionally claiming paths first).

tools.name: task_status
tools.description: One task record, or all task records when task_id is omitted.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Task records; active_only keeps active, collecting and merging tasks.

tools.name: claim_paths
tools.description: Claim path patterns for an active task: all granted, or MT-001 naming the holders.

tools.name: release_paths
tools.description: Release path claims held by an active task.

tools.name: request_shared_op
tools.description: Wait for a slot in a shared-operation queue, run its configured command in the task worktree, release the slot, and return the result.

tools.name: commit_handoff
tools.description: Commit the task's handoff record on its branch (given fields replace those already recorded) and regenerate the AGENTS.md block.

tools.name: collect_task
tools.description: Validate and merge the task into the integration branch (MT-030/031/032 on failure).

tools.name: abort_task
tools.description: Discard an active task: release its claims, remove its worktree, mark it abandoned.

tools.name: render_agents_block
tools.description: Regenerate the Active Sessions block in the root AGENTS.md and return it.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Flush local claim events and pull remote ones (refs/meshtree/coord).
